title: BA Forecast Scorecard: scoring U.S. balancing authorities' day-ahead load forecasts from EIA-930
description: Daily scoring of every U.S. balancing authority's own day-ahead demand forecast using the public EIA-930 six-month balance files (hourly demand, day-ahead demand forecast, imputation flags). Computes MAPE, bias, RMSE and peak-hour error per BA-day, aggregates by month, year and named grid event, applies explicit data-quality rules, and publishes rankings and summaries. Part of the Cardinal Grid open initiative: cardinalgrid.com/scorecard.
